runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **HK$0.38** a share (3303.HK last trade 2026-10-16; Yahoo chart API, aggregator, flagged); ADR JUTOY last trade US$12.54 on 2026-10-14 (aggregator, flagged, thin); 250 shares per ADS from the depositary's F-6EF of 2009-04-23, accession 0001019155-09-000474. Shares **2,488,835,287**, one class, no treasury shares (HKEX Monthly Return for September 2026, 2026100600381; checked against the rights-issue results, 2026031901220: 2,133,287,389 plus 355,547,898), by hand, `Screens/cover_shares.py` and `tools/run.py` refused the name; cap HK$945.8M = RMB810.1M; net cash RMB221.3M at 2026-06-30. Sovereign **2.06%**, the 30-year point of the PRC Ministry of Finance China Treasury Yield Curve as published by ChinaBond, 2026-10-16 (no RMB row in the protocol's table, said so). FX the CFETS central parity 2026-10-16, HK$1 = RMB0.85658. Filings read: annual reports FY2013 to FY2025 (the FY2025 report HKEX 2026042900381), the 2026 interim report (2026092900313), four profit warnings 2025 to 2026, the SDN announcements (2024061300915, 2025101400296), the rights-issue documents, the supplementary announcement of 2026-10-09 (2026100900109), the 2022 requisition circular and poll, the 2024 CEO change; one figure cross-checked: FY2025 revenue RMB799,930,000 in the statement of profit or loss against the MD&A. The brief departed in two stated places: a name with no SEC filings (HKEX documents as primary, HKEX file references in place of accessions, the RMB sovereign from the MOF curve), and lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 annual report (eight chosen). **Q1 IN** (a tendered fabrication yard, readable off twelve years of its own figures; revenue RMB659M to RMB3,982M to RMB800M 2015 to 2025; the cycle question sent to Q2 and Q7). **Q2 OUT**: no castle; work "generally through tendering" with customers changing year to year, gross margin 2.4% to 27.3% 2014 to 2025 and 0.9% in the first half of 2026; capacity bought with capital, Jutal itself building a new Zhuhai berth at about RMB200M; no low-cost position shown, return on average equity about 2.7% a year 2014 to 2025 against COOEC about 6.6%, Wison a cumulative owners' loss of about RMB817M, Gulf Island about -US$184M 2014 to 2024; the field ordinary at best over the full cycle; the position narrowing under the SDN listing; oil and gas deciding at about 101% of 2021 to 2025 gross profit, new energy and refining -RMB24M. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** the SDN listing under EO 14024 after the Arctic LNG 2 module work and the CEO's resignation eleven days later; qualified opinions FY2021 to FY2023 on a liquidated-damages provision booked at RMB65M and settled at RMB138.6M; the 2022 requisition by the then controlling shareholder defeated about 45 to 55; RMB512.7M paid from share premium in 2021 against 2020 profit of RMB146.7M; RMB144.7M of shares bought in 2024 and awarded vesting on grant, 32M to the Chairman, share-based charges 63% of 2024 profit; four share issues for cash, the count from 800M (2016) to 2,489M; 2025 pre-tax profit carried by a RMB74.7M warranty reversal. Owner cash by hand from the filed cash-flow statements: 2021 to 2025 average **RMB54.6M all-equity, RMB49.0M equity-only**; twelve years RMB22.7M all-equity; first half 2026 about -RMB268M. COMPUTATION on the Q7 construction (cycle base 2021 to 2024, peak to peak, the last year aberrational; no growth, growth between cycles changing sign; a CONVENTION of the run carries the depreciation variant as the bottom because capital spending ran below depreciation over the base): value **HK$1.62 to HK$2.77** a share (RMB1.39 to 2.37), fair **HK$0.535 all-equity** (HK$0.394 equity-only), against HK$0.38; on the literal 2021 to 2025 window fair about HK$0.31, on the twelve-year record about HK$0.21, both below the price; the cycle base is the Arctic LNG 2 years; not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. Contamination declared by the analyst: the IOGPQ commit subjects, other runs' research-folder names in git status (AYI, ARCB) and the memory index lines; none used; no blind-listed file opened, listed or searched. Commits aad7b07f, 0aa93675, 38313358, 4edf6937, c47bc0b8. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for JUTOY, Jutal or 3303). Citations: the analyst's check PASS; the dispatcher's `_verify_dispatch.py` 68 citations of 49 ids, no phantom, no E-id, 27 quoted fragments, no slip. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): (1) specific (a) can send the base to a cycle whose peak came from business the company can no longer do (here the sanctioned Arctic LNG 2 work); (2) "peak to peak" does not say which years count (2020 to 2023 gives RMB205.0M, 2021 to 2024 RMB117.0M); (3) a no-growth range has one end, so the width test and the fair-price average have nothing to work on; (4) Q2's commodity paragraph (TOO HARD (WORK) where cost cannot be read) and its OUT item for ordinary field returns can send a contract fabricator to different boxes; (5) no RMB row in the protocol's sovereign table. Could not get: the segment-results and tax notes, COOEC's full reports (summaries only), Gulf Island FY2025, the settlement of the 2017 Penglai purchase.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: no castle, tendered fabrication work bought on the bid (gross margin 2.4% to 27.3% 2014 to 2025, 0.9% in the first half of 2026), yard capacity that capital adds, return on equity about 2.7% a year against COOEC about 6.6% with Wison and Gulf Island losing money in aggregate, and a position narrowing since OFAC put the Penglai yard on the SDN List in June 2024 after its Arctic LNG 2 module work. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the SDN listing and the CEO's exit eleven days later, qualified opinions FY2021 to FY2023, a defeated 2022 requisition by the controlling shareholder, RMB512.7M paid from share premium in 2021, 2024 award shares vesting on grant, four share issues for cash. COMPUTATION on the Q7 construction: value HK$1.62 to HK$2.77 a share, fair HK$0.535 all-equity (HK$0.394 equity-only) against HK$0.38, resting on the Arctic LNG 2 years; on the literal window fair about HK$0.31 and on twelve years about HK$0.21; not armed. Framework notes for the operator: a cycle base built on vanished business, peak-to-peak years undefined, a one-ended no-growth range, and no RMB row in the sovereign table.
